mustFix.problem: Horizontal overflow at 390px (page 415px wide) and 320px (page 413px wide). Widest: div.checker__symptom (right 415), div.checker__zip (right 415), article.review-card.card (right 764), span.level-tag (right 582), p inside review cards (right 739).
mustFix.fix: Add overflow-x: hidden to body or .wrap; constrain checker__symptom, checker__zip, review-card.card, level-tag to max-width: 100% and box-sizing: border-box; audit all .wrap children for fixed widths exceeding viewport.

mustFix.problem: Review cards overflow to 764px on 390px viewport — nearly double-width.
mustFix.fix: Ensure article.review-card.card has width: 100%; max-width: 100%; overflow: hidden and child p wraps rather than forcing width.

elevate.move: Restructure the symptom checker as a vertical stack of full-width tap targets with the flue-rail as a left accent bar, turning the overflow bug into a signature-aligned mobile pattern.

Insert a narrow t-paper flue cross-section divider between proof and prices that echoes the hero arch at miniature scale, transforming the tone collision into a signature beat that reinforces the chimney-as-site metaphor.
